H1805.def: a pail or jar (for drawing water)

H1806.derivation: or (prolonged) דְּלָיָהוּxlit Dᵉlâyâhhûw corrected to Dᵉlâyâhûw; from H1802 (דָּלָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has delivered;
H1806.def: Delajah, the name of five Israelites

H1809.def: to slacken or be feeble; figuratively, to be oppressed

H1811.def: to drip; by implication, to weep

H1814.kjv: burning, chase, inflame, kindle, persecute(-or), pursue hotly.

H1819.kjv: compare, devise, (be) like(-n), mean, think, use similitudes.

H1820.def: to be dumb or silent; hence, to fail or perish; trans. to destroy
H1820.kjv: cease, be cut down (off), destroy, be brought to silence, be undone, [idiom] utterly.

H1823.def: resemblance; concretely, model, shape; adverbially, like

H1826.kjv: cease, be cut down (off), forbear, hold peace, quiet self, rest, be silent, keep (put to) silence, be (stand) still, tarry, wait.

H1834.derivation: or דּוּמֶשֶׂק; or דַּרְמֶשֶׂק; of foreign origin;

H1840.derivation: in Ezekiel it is; דָּנִאֵל; from H1835 (דָּן) and H410 (אֵל); judge of God;

H1842.derivation: from H1835 (דָּן) and (apparently) H3282 (יַעַן); judge of purpose;

H1845.derivation: from H3045 (יָדַע) and H410 (אֵל); known of God;

H1846.def: to be extinguished; figuratively, to expire or be dried up

H1848.derivation: from an unused root (meaning to push over);

H1851.def: crushed, i.e. (by implication) small or thin

H1858.def: properly, a pearl (from its sheen as rapidly turned); by analogy, pearl-stone, i.e. mother-of-pearl or alabaster

H1860.derivation: or דֵּרָאוֹן; from an unused root (meaning to repulse);

H1862.derivation: apparently from H1858 (דַּר) and H1843 (דֵּעַ); pearl of knowledge;

H1864.def: the south; poet. the south wind

H1865.derivation: from an unused root (meaning to move rapidly);
H1865.def: freedom; hence, spontaneity of outflow, and so clear

H1866.derivation: the same as H1865 (דְּרוֹר), applied to a bird;
H1866.def: the swift, a kind of swallow

H1868.def: {Darejavesh, a title (rather than name) of several Persian kings}

H1884.def: meaning one skilled in law; a judge

H1886.derivation: or (Aramaic dual) דֹּתַיִן; (Genesis 37:17), of uncertain derivation;

H1894.derivation: only in plural, from an unused root meaning to be hard;

H1895.derivation: a primitive root of uncertain (perhaps foreign) derivation;

H1896.derivation: or (by permutation) הֵגַי; probably of Persian origin;

H1897.def: to murmur (in pleasure or anger); by implication, to ponder
